text: You know what Setup and Maintenance looks like and what you're building. This lesson covers the engine behind both: Functional Setup Manager, the tool that decides which setup tasks exist and organizes them into a trackable list.

Oracle Fusion contains far more setup tasks than any one implementation needs. FSM takes your choice of offerings, like Financials, and functional areas within them, and generates exactly the task list that matches, including every prerequisite.

That generated list lives inside an implementation project. You pick the offering and functional areas, and FSM builds a hierarchical task list automatically. Oracle recommends scoping a project to no more than one offering.

The task list is a tracking tool: each task gets an owner, a status, and notes. The predefined offering top task list already reflects the correct dependency order, so prerequisite tasks never show up out of order.
FSM turns your choice of offerings into a generated, trackable task list. That closes out chapter one. Chapter two starts building: legal entities and ledgers.
